title: Vault of Wealth
coreRelationships: The stack of money is centrally positioned and illuminated, drawing immediate attention.
The credit cards form a base for the money, suggesting a hierarchy of financial instruments.
The vault door and mechanism provide a secure, imposing backdrop.
The spotlight creates a strong focal point and emphasizes the texture of the money and marble.
reuseFormula: Recreate a bank vault interior with a dark, metallic aesthetic. Place a polished black marble plinth centrally. On the plinth, stack a large amount of US hundred-dollar bills, and beneath them, a smaller stack of credit cards. Illuminate these objects with a strong, overhead spotlight, casting dramatic shadows. Add atmospheric mist or fog to enhance depth and mood. Ensure the vault door and its mechanisms are visible in the background.
